notes.title: SPEEDONS
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today at 3pm CET, Ghostland Yard is going to be speedrun at the [i][url=https://speedons.fr/]Speedons [/url][/i]event!

You can find the event on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistermv]mistermv twitch channel[/url]

"Speedons is [i]Médecins du Monde[/i]’s speedrunning marathon
For 75 hours, donations are collected to finance their actions. 

Created in 1980, Médecins du Monde is an international solidarity activist medical association that fights tirelessly to defend a just and universal health system.

Médecins du Monde fights with actions and rights, through advocacy and field actions, in France with 59 programs and internationally in around thirty countries.

For Médecins du Monde, defending health is not only about treating, it is also about listening, supporting, protecting, collaborating, defending, training, pleading. It means attacking the sources of a problem to make its symptoms disappear with a local, collective and sustainable approach."

The game will be run by Toniob, Seby and Jarm0u! We hope you'll enjoy the event!

notes.title: Base price change
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and happy new year! 

It's been over a year since Ghostland Yard was fully released on Steam! We'd like to thank our community for their support and dedication, it's a real pleasure to see people competing for the best time. 

After careful consideration, we decided to adapt the price of the game, from 16.99$USD to [b]11.99$ USD[/b]. 

The base price will not change again for a year [i](except during sales)[/i], we will probably put the game at 9.99$USD on January 2026. 

We are still working on the Nintendo Switch version of the game, but we do not have an ETA to give you at the moment, in the next few months if all goes well.

Best regards,

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[b]Ghostland Yard[/b] update [b]1.2[/b] is now available!
Today, we're pushing one of the biggest update yet, and you may not notice anything new! Yeah!

As we prepare the console version of the game, we have made a lot of changes to the way data is handled in the game. The overall build size will unfortunately be larger, from 600Mb to 900Mb, but the individual scenes will load much faster. You may have to re-download the whole game as we have drastically changed the way we handle assets, sorry about that. 

The main menu was entirely reworked, as the leaderboard panel and the stats info panel at the end of each stages. 

If you experienced small stuttering before, rejoice, they should be gone now!

Also, we added a small modification on how the game handles resolution: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/4d9e3f337300234d337421b191ff92223ca43898.png[/img]

The game now [b]supports ultra wide resolution[/b]! In a future update, we will add additional features to change your resolution, and change between fullscreen / windowed!

Here's the [b]patchnote[/b]: 

[list]
[*]Main menu was reworked: going from 14.000 game objects to 2.000, making the scene loading way faster
[*]Leaderboard panel was reworked and visually slightly improved
[*]Stage endpanel was reworked and visually slightly improved
[*]Background visual of every scenes was improved, expect some minor difference  with the previous version
[*]Changed time display separator from a xx : yy : zz format to a better format [i](thx Tara) [/i]
[*]Changed how music variation was picked: music is now pick randomly between the different variation when you start a world 
[*]Chinese translations were improved 
[*]And a lot of other small improvements
[/list]

[b]Known issues[/b]: 
[list]
[*]The navigation in the scene selection menu is not as smooth as it used to be, but we will fix it in the next patch
[*]The xenomorph and asteroids in the 6th world took some time off, they will be back shortly 
[*]The loading spinning wheel in the bottom right of the game sometime doesnt spin to win, and we dont know why and it's a minor issue, it might stay like that forever 
[*]We encountered a very rare bug: in speedrun mode after navigating in the options and trying to go back to the main menu, the game crashed. We were not able to replicate this bug, but if you encounter it, please let us know
[/list]

As said previously, you may not see any differences between the previous version and this one, but we can guarantee you that we made a lot of modifications in the backend. We will write a devlog about this optimization update and the console version of the game in the future, so you will be able to see exactly how we made the optimization and why we made it! 

This update has been very important for us, as it has laid the foundations for the version that will be on the console of our best plumber before the end of the year.


As always, if you see any issues in the game or if you have any feedback, do not hesitate to communicate them on our discord or steam forum. In the coming days we will hotfixes some remaining bugs and continue to polish the game. 

Talk to you soon,

The Obelisk Studio team

[b]Ghostland Yard[/b] update 1.1.0 is now available!

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes:
[h1]IT.IS.DONE.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/23eb986a731c16dad409014ac2a9ee729137849f.png[/img]

We are all very proud here at Obelisk Studio. This is it, after almost three years in the making, [b]Ghostland Yard v.1.0[/b] is now live. And it is live thanks to our [b]dedicated players[/b] who helped us during the early access!

This final update brings minor bug fixes, optimizations, the long awaited cutscenes, brand new sound effects and improved sound mixing ! 

In the game, you can now find:
[list]
[*]20 classic level per world
[*]1 bonus race level per world
[*]1 boss fight per world
[*]6 worlds with their unique visuals, features and music
[*]120 additional level -Apocalypse- with new and revisited stages
[*]Friend and World Leaderboard
[*]Replay mode
[*]Race mode 
[*]Speedrun mode
[*]Some great accessibility features
[/list]

Ghostland Yard is [b]our very first game here[/b] at Obelisk Studio. The studio started with two schoolmates, then a third joined and we officially created the company, then a friend joined us, now we're discussing with 3 additional people to join the studio. 

[strike]This was quite an adventure [/strike]
[b]This is only the beginning of our journey![/b]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Now that the game is released on PC, what's next for [b]Ghostland Yard[/b] and [b]Obelisk Studio[/b]? 

First of all, we won't be very far. Our discord and steam forum will remain open and we will keep a close eye to your feedback. If you find any weird situation or issue, do not hesitate to report them directly to us, we will do our possible to fix this as soon as possible. [i](kudo for Ampo one of or programmer who sometime patched small issues in less than an hour after the report!)[/i]

[b]We started to work on our future title [/b][i](we won't talk about this one before a veryyy long time)[/i], but we are also still working on the other versions of Ghostland Yard! 

As said in a precedent post, we're working on the Nintendo Switch version! We will update the PC version in 2.0 once the console version is done, this update should drastically improve performances. (this update should happen Q2 2024). We will try to release Ghostland Yard on as many platforms as possible!

This project was made possible thanks to the incredible people who supported us during the development.

Talk to you "soon"!

[h2]Some bugfixes[/h2]

[list]

notes.title: Major Update #3: The Apocalypse
notes.notes:
[h1]This is it, the third major update for Ghostland Yard is now available!
[/h1]
Named [b]"The Apocalypse"[/b], this update brings the first part of the Apocalypse World! This bonus world is divided in 6 smaller ones, you can access the first 3 apocalypse world: 
[list]
[*][b]The Caves Apocalypse[/b]
[*][b]The Castle Apocalypse[/b]
[*][b]The Temple Apocalypse[/b]
[/list]
You now have [b]60 more stages[/b] to discover! Note that they are no souls to collect in the apocalypse world, but you still have medals to earn! 

This update will be split in two parts, the first part wont include the music and new sound effects for this world and will contain only half of the stages, the rest will come later this summer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/a764647a003847bb3c30612fffdd340a5171c06d.png[/img]

Still inspired by the early access of Against the Storm developped by the amazing Eremite Games, we are going to indicate which changes were inspired by the community with a 💎


[h2]💎Gameplay improvement[/h2]

We made two improvement on the character controller based on your feedback. 
[list]
[*][b]Vertical coyote time[/b]
[*][b]Jump-buffering for multijump pickable[/b]
[/list]
The first one, [b]the vertical coyote time[/b], is working exactly as the horizontal one: if you're not grounded anymore, the game allows you to jump for a very small amount of time! This was not the case before and made the experience inconsistent between the floor jumps and the wall jumps.

The second one, [b]the jump buffering for the multijump pickables[/b], will greatly improve the experience on some stages in the 5th world - the submarne base. Basically, if you press jump just a few frames before picking up the multijump pickable, it will save your jump input, and you will perform a jump once you pickup the bonus. 

This wasn't the case before and it caused some frustrations, now they're gone! 

[h2]New checkpoint system for the bosses[/h2]

The final boss of the game was designed with checkpoints in mind, but this wasn't the case for the other bosses, so we thought, why not? 

You can now access in the options the checkpoint panel: you can choose to leave it by default (with only the chekpoints enabled for the 6th boss), or you can customize your experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/6012c8f22f230cbb7c68bc4089558c0675dbb1c4.png[/img]

We also made some bug fixes and optimizations on the game! We still have some work to do on the optimization part but the game is already pretty stable and smooth and we are quite happy with the result.


[h2]Some good news[/h2]

We wanted to share with you two good news: today is Pierre's birthday, our art director! Happy birthday! For this very special day, his daughter made the very first fanart we ever received for Ghostland Yard, do you recognize Poe ?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/053d80b55261cd2d678773069bc084a1ff20c36b.png[/img]

The second good news is that we may have a release date... [b]October 31st 2023[/b], for Halloween! 

We will make an official announcement very soon, but this is almost it: the game is going v.1.0 before the end of this year, yeah!


As usual, we are still eager to hear your feedback, do not hesitate to use the "feedback" panel in game or to join us on discord. Thank you very much for your support and feedback! 

Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Update 0.9.1.1
notes.notes:
Ghostland Yard update 0.9.1.1 is now available! This update brings the final boss of the game, yeah! As usual, do not hesitate to give us feedback and to tell us what you think. We are pleased with the result, but there is always room for improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/e108d70f931edd76295bd34ac94495c06bb99973.png[/img]

The changes indicated with a 💎 were inspired by your feedback, thank you for your support!

[list]
[*]Final boss: the boss is now playable
[*]💎2nd Boss: added a small delay at the beginning of phase 2 so players have more time to understand what's going on 
[*]💎[b]607[/b]: level was reworked base on your feedback, note that your time and replay for this stage was removed
[*]💎[b]Options[/b]: you can now access most of the options directly from the pause menu 
[*]💎[b]Leaderboard[/b]: you can now access the leaderboard directly from the pause menu, meaning that you can start a replay or a race against one of your friends or one of the Top10 in the world without having to go back to the main menu, [b]FINALLY[/b]
[/list]

We[b] are done with the main content[/b] of the game, this is a very important milestone for us! In the coming weeks, we are going to release some minor updates bringing QoL improvements, bugfixes and some polish on various things while we are still working on the Apocalypse World. 

We are at this very moment at 50% of the Apocalypse world done (60/120 levels). If everything goes right [i](note that it rarely is the case)[/i], we should be able to push the Major Update #3 at the end of July. 

Regarding the Apocalypse World update, we still have some plans for few improvements: 
[list]
[*]A [b]godmode [/b]in the options to help you pass the most difficult stages (note that this godmode will probably break some parts of the game!)
[*][b]Improved character controller[/b]: there is no vertical coyote time nor prejump for the multijump pickable at the moment and those were requested, we are going to work on it very soon
[*][b]Level order modification[/b]: some stages inside a world are not are their right place, we are going to balance the order in order to smooth the difficulty curve
[*][b]Polish[/b]: some visual effects and sound effects deserve a bit more love and the overall mixing of the game needs a bit more cooking before the final release
[/list]

[h3]For the Apocalypse Update, there might be a little change of plan though as we met some publishers for Ghostland Yard! [/h3]

The[b] console version[/b] (Nintendo Switch) is still planned but we do not have any ETA to give you yet. There is a timeline where we have to delay the v.1.0 PC release in order to make a multiplaftorm release in 2024, but this will happen only if we find a deal with a publisher. Otherwise, the game will release on PC at the end of the summer, and on Nintendo Switch sometime in the future


We are still eager to hear your feedback, do not hesitate to use the "feedback" panel in game or to join us on discord. We are building this game for you the players, so if you like or dislike anything, let us know and we will see what we can do to improve your experience!

Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Major Update #2: The Space Station
notes.notes:
Finally, the second major update for Ghostland Yard is now available! Named "The Space Station", this update  brings a brand new world with his new race, a new feature, some bug fixes and more!

This update will be split in two parts, the first part wont include the boss or the cutscenes which are still work in progress :(

Still inspired by the early access of Against the Storm developped by the amazing Eremite Games, we are going to indicate which changes were inspired by the community with a 💎

[h2]New world: the Space Station[/h2]

Explore a brand new world... in space! You will find twenty new stages and one bonus stage in this last update. The final boss isn't ready yet, but he's coming very soon! Note that the speedrun mode for the 6th world is not available yet, it will be unlocked once we push the update with the last boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/b52aee3f3813604665de121294147c66218ff951.png[/img]

[h2]💎User Experience improvement[/h2]

You can now access almost every options available directly from a level instead of going back to the main menu! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/ffa50d12463add35d1a6053074bc968d9812549e.png[/img]

We also added a button "restart" in the pause panel. We have plans to add the leaderboard panel inside the pause panel, so you will be able to start a replay/race without going back to the level selection menu.

[h2]💎Visuals improvement and optimization[/h2]

We worked on the rendering and optimization of some elements:
[list]
[*]Improved performances on the Sumbarine World
[*]Reworked foreground visuals on the Submarine World
[*]Reworked the lighting and rendering on the Submarine Boss (still WIP) 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/27dff85ed6d4683124f9e26fa0d4ad6537f3ea73.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes and modifications:[/h2]
[list]
[*]💎Added an audio feedback for the unlock race animation in the level selection menu 
[*]Fixed a visual feedback issue on the 5th Boss
[*]Fixed an issue with long nickname not displaying correctly
[*]💎 Small nerf on the Castle Boss: you will now have a small second at the end of the elevator before the boss start chasing you
[*]And some minor tweaks on some stages!
[/list]

We are getting closer to the v.1.0! We are still working on the Apocalypse World, the 6th and final boss and the cutscenes. We still need more data and feedback before doing the main balancing work, but we will change some level layout and swap some stages to smooth the progression 

We will push another update in the coming weeks with the final boss! We are still working on the Apocalypse World, to apologize for the delayed and 2 parts update, here is a teaser of what is coming next... it's going to be a hot summer! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/a764647a003847bb3c30612fffdd340a5171c06d.png[/img]

As usual, we are still eager to hear your feedback, do not hesitate to use the "feedback" panel in game or to join us on discord. Remember, we are building this game for you the players, so if you like or dislike anything, let us know and we will see what we can do to improve your experience! 

Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Early access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Today, I’m going to talk about the release of the game and the future of [b]Ghostland Yard[/b]. The game was originally scheduled to be released in February 2023, which was later postponed to the end of March 2023.
At [b]Obelisk Studio[/b], we have certain values that are very important to us, one of which is none other than [b]transparency[/b]. So let’s be transparent: 

[h3]We cannot release Ghostland Yard in v.1.0 at the end of March 2023 with the level of quality we want to get. [/h3]

The hazards of video game production - and life in general - force us to [b]change our plans[/b], and we are sincerely sorry that we have failed to stick to the planned schedule. 
We seriously looked at our various options and those were the three major possibilities that emerged: 

[list]
[*][b]Maintain release in Q1 2023[/b], but release with [b]pain an unfinished product[/b], with lack of polish and try to correct and fix the flaws afterwards 
[*][b]Postpone the release for several weeks/months[/b], but this implies a big reorganisation of our plans and puts the future of Obelisk Studio in danger 
[*][b]Release the game very soon in early access[/b] and assume that the game is not finished, and finish it with the help and support of the community
[/list]
The [b]early access[/b] option turns out to be the best decision for us to make at the moment. It was not planned - we had already studied this opportunity a year ago and decided not to go out in early access - but we have no better option to propose. 


We therefore announce that Ghostland Yard will be released in [b]early access on March 28, 2023[/b] on [b]Steam[/b]! You will have in this early access version: 

[list]
[*] [b]World 1[/b] with his race and boss (22 levels in total)
[*] [b]World 2[/b] with his race and boss (22 levels in total)
[*] [b]World 3[/b] with his race and boss (22 levels in total)
[*] [b]World 4[/b] with his race and boss (22 levels in total)
[*] The [b]friend leaderboard[/b] 
[*] [b]Replay[/b] mode 
[*] [b]Speedrun[/b] mode 
[*] The [b]introduction cinematic[/b] of the game 
[/list]

Early access on PC will help us deliver a quality 1.0 version - both on PC and consoles - while thanking PC buyers for their help and participation in this early access.

Here is the [b]roadmap[/b] for this early access: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/92ad2ed26c776ae32034739b029cfe105d5b885b.png[/img]

Early access involves several things: 

[list]
[*][b] A reduced early access price compared to the release price[/b]: if you buy a product that is not finished, you do not have to pay full price, it seems to us the least of things. In order to thank buyers for early access, we think we will reduce the game by about 30% compared to its final price (we had envisaged a price between €11.99 and €14.99, if we release in early access, the game would be around €9 to €10).
[*] [b]A roadmap with predefined updates[/b]: we have proven through the various updates of the demo that we are able to propose improvements and additional content regularly. I must specify that we [b]will not increase the scope of the project[/b] during early access but we will take advantage of it to refine and finish the content originally planned.
[*] [b]Special listening to community feedback[/b]: in addition to transparency, we believe in design through iteration. Feedback have always had a central place in the development of Ghostland Yard, and with a early access, we will take as many returns as possible into account to improve the quality of our game. We must not forget that we make this game for you, the players. 
[/list]

So compared to what we still have to produce on the game: 

[list]
[*][b] The world 5[/b]: is realized in terms of level design as well as visuals, it lacks a little visual and sound polish, it will be implemented 4 weeks after the start of the early access 
[*] [b]World Boss 5[/b]: playable, need some more work on the visual aspect
[*] [b]The world 6[/b]: is realized in terms of level design, need some more level art work, it will be added 8 weeks after the early access start
[*] [b]The Boss of the World 6[/b]: is being developed 
[*] [b]Cinematics[/b]: we are on it, each of them require several days of work
[*] [b]The apocalypse world[/b]: work has begun! As these are the classic levels revisited, we do not start from scratch, but several weeks of work are still needed. 
[*] [b]Race mode[/b]: is about 50% complete
[/list]

In addition to the tasks we still have to do, early access will allow us to [b]correct and modify certain elements of the game that do not seem qualitative enough[/b] (while respecting the initial vision of the game). 

For those who are not familiar with early access, know that the game[b] will come out while it is still in development[/b]. If you want to play the fully finished version of the game, it is wiser to wait for its final release in a few months before buying it. 

We are aware that some of you may be disappointed to see the 1.0 release postponed for several months, know that we do not take this decision lightly. 

[b]Know that no matter what the future holds, Ghostland Yard will be released in v.1.0 on PC and Nintendo Switch[/b]. We just can’t guarantee the final release date accurately, but we are doing our best.

If you want to play early, you will be able to play the game in early access at the end of the month, [b]March 28 2023 [/b]to be precise! 

Talk to you soon,  

Thibault

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Thanks to the intervention of two French streamers [b]@Kepin[/b] and [b]@Seldell[/b], we realized that a very important problem was present in the demo of Ghostland Yard. 

The times displayed at the end of the levels had something... odd. It was very difficult for some people to beat the times of their friends, while the jump curves were perfect and the paths taken were very optimal. 

We investigated and created a dedicated test scene to confirm the following hypothesis: "the calculation of time is f****d". 

And indeed, the time calculation was slightly broken. Without going into details, you could, by redoing exactly the same inputs, have a 1 frame offset on your time of one level. 


[i]For example, if you were at 144 frames per second and you were performing a level in 10 seconds, you should theoretically perform that level in 1440 frames. But sometimes not, the time indicated was 1441 frames, and at 144fps, 1 frame = about 7ms. [/i]


This problem also existed with a low framerate, which could create a time lag [b] of more than a tenth of a second[/b], which was not at all fair play. 

One of our programmers [b]@Amédée[/b] quickly identified and fixed the problem, the times are now perfectly consistent between the different runs, but now the accuracy of the times has been reduced to the hundredth and not the thousandth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/74998ca20f8cd0d7a28ddd1b7f2cff1d5c3a8dda.png[/img]

I promised in the post written Monday announced that the removal of leaderboards was normally the last... 

...[b]we will remove the times recorded before the start of steam next fest[/b] in order to put everyone on an equal footing, because some times recorded with the new calculation mode are no longer physically feasible. The wipe of the leaderboard will be effective as soon as this post goes live.

I am truly sorry for the inconvenience, your local backups will not be impacted, but [b]your times will no longer be saved on the steam[/b] servers, and therefore, [b]your replays cannot be launched by your friends[/b]. 

[h3]To take advantage of the latest modifications on the recorded times, we invite you to delete your save in the options[/h3]

Know that we work hard to make the game as pleasant as possible for its release. Do not hesitate to send us your feedback, they are not only very valuable for us, but also taken into account! 

Here is a list of changes since the last release: 

[list]
[*]Fixed a [b]layer issue[/b] where the boss laser gun was rendered on the foreground of the sides of the arena 
[*]Fixed a [b]feedback problem[/b] in options where when the player was trying to remap a key, all keys displayed the selection feedback 
[*]Added [b]R and F keys to navigate[/b] in the leaderboard (in addition to page up and page down keys)
[*][b]Changing fan areas visuals[/b] worldwide 3, should be more visible now
[*][b]Fixed camera for boss 3[/b], boss 3 wasn’t supposed to move with player, oops
[*][b]Added a visual effect on the medals[/b] at the top left of the screen in the classic levels when the target time passes from one medal to another 
[*][b]Added a sound effect[/b] when you earn a medal on the end panel
[*][b]Added a sound effect[/b] to the buttons validation in the end level panel
[*][b]Added caption[/b] for return key in main menu
[/list]

The following is a list of known and unresolved issues at this time: 
[list]
[*]Some players may encounter [b]stuttering[/b] if you have more than 70fps, we have not yet found the cause of the problem, but we are on it 
[*][b]A graphical glitch[/b] may appear on the end of world level 2 panel, a piece of carpet that has nothing to do here and that is driving me f*****g crazy
[*]The big mushrooms in the first world lost their dangling stuff :'( I broke the shader this afternoon, but we're on it!
[/list]

Talk to you soon,

Thibault

notes.title: DEVLOG #0
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi everyone, [/h3]
Thibault, producer at Obelisk Studio here! 

The release of [b]Ghostland Yard[/b] is fast approaching, the game is slowly gaining visibility (besides, a big thank you to all the people who wishlist and who talk about the game around them, you help us a lot!) and people are increasingly interested in the project. 

It is important for us to tell you how this project started, and why we are working on this game. This post -which is normally the first of a series- will explain all this in detail.

[h1]1) You are not prepared[/h1]

Everything started in January 2020. 
I [i](Thibault)[/i], left a Producer job with the desire to create my video game studio. With the help of [b]Emeric[/b], a fellow student and friend, we teamed up to start working on a prototype, a top-down 3D action game in line with the old Zeldas, especially Links Awakening.

With [b]Emeric in programming and me in design[/b], we worked on this project for almost 8 months, from January to September 2020 - in the middle of Covid. [b]Pierre[/b], a former colleague and other friend, helped us with the artistic direction of this project. 

Looking back, I think we took a list of all the things not to do for a first game, and we did everything on that list:

[list]
[*]No deep research on the concept, we just started prototyping a game to please us
[*]No precise definition of the scope at the beginning of the project, so no limits to our creative madness, so no end date of the project 
[*]No skills check-up, and it turned out we didn’t have all the skills to make such a big game with only 2 or 3 people
[*]No market analysis [i](a little game with similarities named Tunic was also in development at that time…)[/i]
[/list]
A programmer and a producer / designer to make a top down adventure action game zelda-like type in 3D without money, what could go wrong? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/91035c8f4a8e4c9227a2e989a208aaaaaceea48b.png[/img]

Long story short, [b]we killled this project[/b] or at least put it in a closet and who knows, maybe one day we’ll pull it out. 

I found a management job in the fall of 2020 and my available time to continue working on this development studio project became very limited… 

…but we didn't want to give up the idea of creating our own studio.

[h1]2) The second project much more conceivable[/h1]

So we went out with Emeric looking for our next project, and he happened to have something on his computer. A few years ago, Emeric prototyped on mobile a 2D platformer without virtual stick, the pitch of this prototype being very simple: it’s super meat boy on mobile, without virtual stick. And it worked pretty well! 

A platformer with simple gameplay, in 2D, on mobile: it seemed much more feasible than the first project! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/f1f2fec79f74a07b0a9faa6e56a82f03024462dc.gif[/img]

Pierre agreed to partner with us and produce the game’s visuals, Emeric for the programming and I for the design and management, it seemed playable. The three founding partners of [b]Obelisk Studio[/b] were ready! 

[b]Ghostland Yard[/b] was born around December 2020. The first six months, [b]Emeric [/b] was alone full-time on the project, I joined him full-time [i](after leaving my management position)[/i] in June 2021, and [b]Pierre[/b] joined us full-time [i](after he also left his position)[/i] in January 2022. 

The first year of production of Ghostland Yard, we focused exclusively on the [b]game feel[/b]: how to control the character, the operation of the camera, the game mechanics, but we will get into the details in other devlogs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/2fbe4f74b7e3f98153073c7341b9190794477883.gif[/img]

Very early in the production and thanks to the help of a close friend [i](who is called Thibaud, it is definitely a very common first name in France[/i]), we abandoned the idea of making this game on mobile to focus on a [b]PC and Consoles version[/b]. 

[h1]3) Why this game? [/h1]

There are three main reasons: 
[list]
[*] [b]Emeric really liked Super Meat Boy[/b] and wanted to make a game to honour it
[*] We did a [b]skills check[/b], and we knew we were capable of such a game 
[*] [b]Our resources were very limited[/b], and we needed to develop a business strategy
[/list]
I will expand on this last point: 

First of all, our resources were limited: we had little money set aside and nothing to pay for.

The [b]France [/b] is an excellent country to start a business, because if you have contributed enough (so worked some time), you are entitled to about 60% of your old salary for up to 24 months [i](18 now, thanks Macron)[/i]. So we had at the beginning of Ghostland Yard less than 24 months of compensation, so [b]maximum two years to release the game[/b] without being in a delicate financial situation.  

Add to that a financial helping hand from our loved ones (against a % of the company’s shares, we are not beasts), and we had enough to pay some bills. 

We have therefore [b]corrected one of the problems encountered during our first prototype[/b]: we have a defined framework linked to our available resources, [b]maximum two years to release the game. [/b]

The market is not very lenient with [b]precision platformer[/b]: there are many on Steam, the main reason being that the concept is easy to understand and that it is a very good gateway for independent developers -hearing that it is “easy” to do. (it’s never easy to make a video game)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/b2bc518f4e9e53fe2ba93218bc8b58bca46c003f.png[/img]
[url=https://howtomarketagame.com/2022/05/30/more-evidence-of-which-genres-steam-shoppers-love-to-play][i]Source[/i][/url]

It was unthinkable for us to base our entire strategy on the immediate profitability of Ghostland Yard -even if we don’t doubt that the game will eventually pay off over time-so we went in a different direction. 

Our strategy is simple: release a first game certainly classic, [b]but well done[/b], in order to prove to the financial actors that yes, we are able to realize a good game in conditions not optimal, so imagine what we could do in better conditions! 

Ghostland Yard’s goal is therefore above all to be a [b]critical success[/b]: we want the players who play our game to be completely satisfied, which is why we do our best to bring a [b]special attention to detail[/b] and [b]offer the most polish game possible[/b], within the limits of our skills and resources available. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/bbcd42ec7a51967f07d93a8e5413dc93212ddda7.png[/img]

Because this first game for our studio will be our business card for the rest of our adventures. 
It is true that the concept is not original and [b]one can think that there is no risk taking[/b].  

The truth is that developing this video game, starting a business, spending our savings, asking our loved ones for help, applying for grants, applying for loans from banks, [b]these are the main risks[/b]!

For this first title, we want to lay a solid foundation for our future adventures. It’s not a one-shot game: we take it out, [strike]we take the money[/strike], and we disappear to return to our respective lives. We are here to stay, and the experience with Ghostland Yard is invaluable to us:

[b]We created a company, we managed:[/b]
[list]
[*] The legal aspect with lawyers 
[*] The accounting aspect with ... accountants
[*] The social aspect of hiring an employee
[/list]
[b]We have (almost) completed a game from start to finish, which implies: [/b]
[list]
[*] Programming 
[*] The realization of 2D assets
[*] Integration of 2D assets
[*] 2D animations (rig, skin, anim)
[*] VFX (visual effects)
[*] The game design 
[*] The level design
[*] The integration of sounds and music (managed by the incredible studio Le Refuge) 
[*] Project Management 
[*] Budget management
[*] The QA
[*] Implementation of the Steam API (with analytics, leaderboard, success) 
[*] Putting the steam page online 
[*] And others I forget 
[/list]
We [b]have learned so much[/b] and [b] made so many mistakes[/b] that we are convinced that our next game will be able to be more innovative, with a bigger scope and madness that were unthinkable for us two years back. 

[b]Ghostland Yard is [/b], we hope,[b] the first game in a long series[/b] for Obelisk Studio. We put all our heart into its development, we hope it will please you. 

And if you like the game, wait to see what we offer you in the next few years! 

[i]From left to right: Emeric, Thibault & Pierre[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/1a5ef27b82fedd7483ce6fbc4cdf82d2cff86d64.png[/img]


Take care of yourself,

Thibault

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & New demo
notes.notes:
[h1]Greatings everyone! [/h1]

It’s been a while since we posted anything here but rest assured, the development is ongoing! We have entered the final phase of the production and the game has gone to [b]BETA[/b], which means that all the features and almost all the content are integrated into the game, it remains only to refine all this: remove bugs, balance and improve some details. 

Let’s start with some good news: we will be participating in the Steam Next Fest with a brand new version of the demo! On the program: 

[list]
[*] Relifted menus
[*] Slightly modified levels 
[*] A brand new boss  
[*] The friends ranking system 
[*] The replay system (yours, and those of your friends!) 
[/list]

The demo has been updated very recently and [b]we have removed saves and saved times[/b] for this new version. This is (normally) the first and last time, we promise. And the demo will remain online after the end of the next steam fest: you can continue to test the game, even after its release! 

Let’s talk about the future, the [b]release of Ghostland Yard[/b] on PC and after. 

Sadly, we have not only good news, we are behind schedule, and the game will be released between [b]the end of February[/b] and [b]the end of March 2023[/b] on PC, rather than mid-February as originally planned. We will use this extra time wisely, and it will allow us to offer you the best possible experience.

Now some additional informations: 

[list]
[*] We plan to set the price at [b]$12.99[/b], [b]with a 25% discount[/b] for the release of the game, bringing it down to $9.99 for the release! 
[*] We want to bring the game on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b]! We have not officially started the steps with Nintendo, but we anticipated the release on their console, and the porting will not be too time consuming or too complex (on paper, but we’ll see how things go). We can expect a release on Switch between mid-summer and mid-autumn 2023! 
[*] We have in the boxes additional levels, which are alternative levels to those existing, like the Dark Mode of Super Meat Boy or the B and C side of Celeste. We intend to integrate them for release on Switch, and add them to the PC version - for free. You will have free additional content for Ghostland Yard in the months following the release! 
[/list]

Know that [b]we are very attentive to the feedback[/b] from the community. We build this game for you -the players-, we want your experience to be as pleasant as possible. Do not hesitate to contact us if you want to send us anything, you can reache us via steam forums, our discord, twitter or by email at contact@obelisk-studio.com 

We look forward to offering you the final version of the game, by then, take care of yourself ! 

Talk to you soon, 

Thibault

notes.title: First major update of the demo
notes.notes:
[h1]We heard you![/h1]
Hello everyone, 

First of all, we want to thank you for your interest in Ghostland Yard, you are almost more than 400 to have downloaded and played the demo in the last four weeks, and many of you have shared with us different feedback and these are overwhelmingly very positive! 

It is nevertheless very important for us to satisfy most of our players, and if the positive feedback reassures us about the quality of the game we produce, [b]it is in priority the negative feedback that we have treated in this first update. [/b]

The three main black spots identified were: 
[olist]
[*]The boss is very unbalanced 
[*]Menu is … functional but ugly 
[*]Character is not reactive enough in the air
[/olist]

We have therefore addressed these three elements in recent weeks, and are very proud to offer you this new version of the demo which, we hope, will please you and show you that we take our players' feedback very seriously! Here is the list of changes:  

[h2]The Boss (WIP): [/h2]
Not far from 40% of players fail to reach the end of the first boss, and although we want to have a demanding game, it was much too difficult! The navigation in the arena should be much better and the difficulty of the boss much less. 

[list]
[*]Survival phases on the sides have been removed 
[*]Phases duration are shorter
[*]Arena has been expanded on the sides 
[*]Platforms positions have been adjusted
[/list] 

[h2]The interface (WIP): [/h2]
If the menus had the merit of existing, we were told that they were particularly ugly. We offer a greatly improved version, it takes a little polish before reaching the final version, but we are getting closer to the final rendering! 
[list]
[*]Total rework of the level selection menu. There is now a unique theme per world panel
[*]Added friend leaderboard feature: you can now compare yourself to the time of your steam friends, yeah! 
[*]Rework of the end-level interface 
[*]Add in-game timer and medals indicator (this option will eventually be in the final game, can be enabled or deactivated) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/5815813b8fd590d4d0e53168056e03eedf3ef9a8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/4e8120843ba5ce287743dbc077aa3e3304f7f51e.png[/img]

[/list] 

[b]Movements:[/b]
We were very proud of our little ghost and the way we can move it: the controls were rather pleasant and the handling at the rendezvous, at least for the majority of the players. But a minority of players continued to find that something was wrong with the way the character was moving, especially in the air. So, after some adjustments and refinements, we arrived at a satisfactory (best game ever made)  result that improves the maneuverability of the character without fundamentally changing its functioning, avoiding having to go back to the levels already built.  

[list]
[*]The acceleration of the character (the time needed to go from 0% to 100% speed while running) has been doubled. 
[*]The visual of the running character was very slightly out of sync with his collisions, which could create a sense of injustice with some dangers, so we reduced the “bounce” effect on the character. 
[*]To keep this cartoon effect, we increased the bounce effect for the character’s eyes (purely visual) 
[*]The descent speed when the player is “glued” to a wall has been halved from 3 meter/sec to 1.5 meter/sec. This should facilitate ascents and descents! 
[*]Acceleration speed in the air has been doubled, allowing for much better control of his character in the air. This should facilitate trajectory corrections and navigation in levels with fans! 
[/list]

We hope to have solved most of the problems present in the game and met the different expectations of the players! We take feedback very seriously because we are committed to providing the best experience possible. Do not hesitate to write us on discord, twitter or steam in order to communicate your feedback, whether positive or negative! After all, as long as there are negative returns, there are things to correct! 

[h2]Known issues: [/h2]
[list]
[*]Race and boss end level screens do not have medal information  
[*]The controller icons do not yet match the controller plugged in, they are for the moment those of an Xbox controller, but we think of the other controllers and new icons are coming soon!
[*]There may be issues with the friends leaderboard display
[*]The leaderboard is not displayed instantly, it takes a few seconds to recover the data from Steam. A loading icon will be integrated soon to avoid this “lag” effect 
[*]Transitions may be missing when the player moves from a scene to the main menu, they will be integrated soon to avoid aswell this “lag” effect 
[*]There is a critical bug that can happen at the end of the boss, resulting in a total freeze of the menu, it will be fixed in the next small update coming this week, sorry!
[/list]

The game comes out in about 16 weeks, we still have a thousand things to do, but each day brings us closer to the final build, and we look forward to offering you the full experience in February 2023! 

Talk to you soon, 
Thibault

notes.title: Game announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]We have a trailer! [/h1]

Greatings everyone and welcome to the Ghostland Yard steam page! We finally announced our very first game, Ghostland Yard, a 2D precision platformer!

We hope that you will enjoy the trailer, we put our heart in this video: we really wanted to showcase the mood of the game without spoiling too much.

[previewyoutube=L9KFcLJ7iVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the game: [/h2]

Ghostland Yard is a precision platformer 2D inspired by one title who shaped this genre for the last decade, [i]Super Meat Boy[/i]. You play as [b]Poe[/b], a little ghost who begins his journey as a Ghostland Yard investigator, but everything went wrong on your first day...

The controls are simple and accessible - move left, right, jump and that's it! Almost instant respawns and smooth character controller keep you running through the world in your quest for the thuth.

[b]What makes the game different from the other platformers out there ?[/b] 

This is a tricky question: as it is our first game, we wanted to start with a very basic concept, and the 2D platformer seemed obvious to us, but it's not an easy task as there is a lot of indie developers making platformers games. We chose to focus our efforts on two pillars: the [b]game feel[/b]
and the [b]content[/b]

[h3]The game feel[/h3]

Making sure that the player has the best possible experience while playing our game is our top priority, so we dedicated a lot of resources into the character: the movement, the jumps, the animations, adding some [b]juice[/b] and other small elements to help the player enjoy moving accross the levels. We are making a difficult game, but the players shouldn't blame anything else than themselves for their (possible) failures: the [b]controls have to be perfect[/b] and the player has to feel 100% in control of his avatar.


The second focus of ours is the render of the game. When we started working on Ghostland Yard, we took a look at the other titles in our category and observed something: more than half of the 2D platformers titles have a pixel-art direction, the other half is mostly minimalist/flat vector art. And this is perfectly understandable as pixel art is one of the most accessible art style for small teams, but we have the chance to count in our members a talented 2D artist, so we opted to try to have an original look, and went for an hand-painted art style. 

So we took the challenge: make the game as pleasant as possible to play and to watch!

[h3]The content[/h3]

For our first title, we didn't want to go full crazy on the scope: we wanted to avoid a development hell, so we had to implement very strict limits. One of those limits was: no additionals features on the character. You can jump and you can run and that's the end of it. So we had to be smart to propose a pleasant experience and to keep the player engaged through the game, to that end we introduce some cool gameplay elements in each new world.

We wanted to make a difficult game, but an accessible one, so we created different ways to enjoy the game with different objectives:

[list]
[*][b]Reach the end of the stage:[/b] this is the way to unlock new stages and to reach the end of the game 
[*][b]Collect each soul per stage:[/b] there is one soul to collect in each stage, and you might unlock some hidden stuff if you collect enough of them!
[*][b]Earn every badges per stage:[/b] if you are fast enough to reach the end, you'll earn one of three badges
[*][b]Complete the bonus stages:[/b] there is one bonus stage per world... if not more! 
[/list]

And there is more in the backstage, but we won't communicate too much about that for now as it is not cooked enough!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]When the game will be released?[/b]
We plan to release the game mid-february 2023 
[*][b]How much the game will cost?[/b]
We are not 100% certain yet, but it will range between 10$USD to 15$USD, we will adjust the price regarding the content (in hours of playtime) and the level of polish we can put into the game
[*][b]Will the price be adjusted per country?[/b]
Yes. We want as many players as possible to get their hands on our game and are fully aware that 10$USD might not sound that much for some, but quite expensive for others.
[*][b]What is the current state of the development? [/b]
We are roughly 75% to 80% done with the content of the game. We are confident (for now) that we can deliver the game in time for February 2023
[*][b]Will the game offer some challenge? [/b]
Yes. We designed the game to be somehow challenging, but accessible for most of the users. "Easy to pickup, hard to master" was -and still is- a strong guideline for us.
[*][b]Is there any assistance to help me beat the game? [/b]
Yes. Accessibility is very important to us, and with that in mind we will propose some ways to help you beat the game. Note that enabling the assistance will disable the achievements for your save file!
[*][b]Will the game release on other plaftorms? [/b]
Yes. We plan to release the game on PC -on steam and other marketplaces-, but there is more... We plan to release the game on Nintendo Switch 6 months after the PC release, and maybe on other consoles if the game hits its financial goals.
[*][b]What is the size of the team working on the game? [/b]
 We are 3 developpers in Obelisk Studio: a project manager, a 2D artist and a programmer. We have a partnership with a sound studio, "[i]Le Refuge[/i]" in charge of the sound & music part of the game.
[*][b]Will you develop some additional content after the release of the game?[/b]
To be absolutely honest, we don't know yet. Being an indie studio is kinda random and if we do have some visibility for the coming months, our efforts will be put into completing the game development, releasing the game in his best possible state and then focus on the Nintendo Switch release.
[/list]

And that's it for this first post, more will come in the coming [strike]weeks[/strike] days as we have a big surprise coming, you might be able to get your hands on the game earlier than February 2023...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782645/ee6497dc5258e61f3a392a3ca12815e30efaa93e.png[/img]

Talk to you soon, 
Thibault
